title: Spellforge Insectarium
description: A gothic woman with magenta hair and black dress stands in front of an open, chain-wrapped display booth labeled 'SPELLFORGE INSECTARIUM - GARDEN OF CHAINS'. The booth contains various large pinned insects and a crowned queen wasp. The scene is set on cracked ground with glowing lava, surrounded by dark roses, chains, and flames under a fiery sky.
